name: EvilEye-TS-TW
blurb: An eye with animated irises that tracks your cursor and flickers.
description: WebGL component rendering an eye with procedural-noise irises and a pupil that follows cursor position. Uses shader-based animation with continuous flickering and easing.
use_when: You need a striking, hypnotic focal point that rewards interaction — hero sections or loading states.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces, performance-critical contexts, or when the component cannot fill a sized parent container.
a11y: Purely visual; cursor tracking has no keyboard alternative, and there's no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
